name: Imprison! Gardevoir ex Constructed Standard Deck

releases.name: Imprison! Gardevoir ex Constructed Standard Deck

description.text: Imprison! Gardevoir ex, a ready-built 60-card deck released on 29 June 2006 alongside the Offense and Defense of the Furthest Ends expansion and built around a δ Delta Species Gardevoir ex of the Fire type. While it is the Active Pokémon, its Imprison Poké-Power can put an Imprison marker on one of the opponent's Pokémon, which then can't use Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies. A coin, damage counters and markers, and a rule book came with it.
